name: v0.38.3
body:
Screen text uses British spelling, and titles use a colon in place of a dash; the docs site shows new recordings of the editor, charts and plans.

### Changed

- Screen text uses British spelling (colour, materialised view; the connection form's row reads
  "Colour") and no longer uses the em dash: titles read "Changes: Result 1 · shop.users",
  "Apply changes: shop.users" and "Edit connection: name". Config keys, theme tokens and commands are unchanged (`color`, `[colors]`,
  `:explain analyze`).

The archives are for macOS and Linux (arm64 and x86_64) and Windows (x86_64); SHA256SUMS lists their checksums. The Windows build is untested: CI builds it and runs its tests, but nobody has used datarig on Windows yet.


## What's Changed
* docs: open the README with a recording, why datarig, and its features by @DokaDev in https://github.com/DokaDev/datarig/pull/236
* ci: completion and social preview recordings, demo stills on pull requests, faster render by @DokaDev in https://github.com/DokaDev/datarig/pull/239
* docs: use British spelling and no em dash in public text by @DokaDev in https://github.com/DokaDev/datarig/pull/240
* ci: read GitHub's host keys for the Homebrew tap with the job's token by @DokaDev in https://github.com/DokaDev/datarig/pull/241
* docs: chart and plan view recordings, and a check of the demo files by @DokaDev in https://github.com/DokaDev/datarig/pull/242
* chore(release): 0.38.3 by @DokaDev in https://github.com/DokaDev/datarig/pull/243


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/DokaDev/datarig/compare/v0.38.2...v0.38.3
